name: Kaeya
rotation: Clockwise as seen on the X/Z card plane. Entire projected shot curve has clockwise signed curvature, not just a matching initial tangent.
look: Lit translucent ice with glossy IOR1.31 reflections, softened edges, variable roughness, milky trapped ice and interior fissures; visible cold mist and grains surround each icicle and follow the flight; shatter, powder and short cold flash at impact.

exports.Kaeya_FrostMist.fbx: Single soft, irregular, vertex-alpha cold wisp; origin zero. Shared by the formal state and flight renderer.
exports.Kaeya_FrostGrain.fbx: Single crystalline grain at origin; shared by the formal orbit and flight renderer.
exports.Kaeya_Icicle.fbx: Reusable static local-Z-forward crystalline mesh; place at current orbit position and orient along the path tangent.
exports.Kaeya_Orbit_3Icicles.fbx: Continuous 3-icicle state loop at local origin, 2.4 seconds, duplicated endpoint.
exports.Kaeya_Orbit_4Icicles.fbx: Continuous C6 visual 4-icicle loop at local origin, same orbit direction and duration.
exports.Kaeya_IceImpact.fbx: Reusable single-target shatter, contact local frame 2, clears by frame 25; target origin is zero.
exports.Kaeya_GlacialWaltz_Effect.fbx: ONE clockwise shot with flight mist/grains and matching shatter, frames1..44, contact16; no sustained orbit geometry. Baked source/target are authoring references.
exports.Kaeya_GlacialWaltz_Demo.fbx: Combined reference, 3 independently triggered projectiles. No cards, camera, or authoring controls.

flightContract.path: Degree-elevated quadratic stored as cubic P0,P1,P2,P3. P1 follows current clockwise orbit tangent; P2=P1+(P3-P0)/3. Select a departure icicle with negative projected cross(tangent,target-P0), preserving clockwise curvature throughout the arc.
flightContract.timing: u=clamp(t/flightDuration,0,1)^1.6. Trail samples previous times on the SAME path. One actual trigger gives one launch and one contact.
flightContract.orbit: Never restart orbit phase on trigger. Briefly hide only the departing slot and reform it on the continuously advancing orbit.
flightContract.targeting: Use actual status caster/orbit host and actual trigger target; never choose an enemy from this demo layout.

materials: VFXColor RGBA on every effect mesh. Body blends transparent and lit Principled surfaces at vertex alpha0.66, IOR1.31/coat/variable roughness; ice interior and mist use separate soft noisy transparency. Recreate these materials in Unity; FBX does not carry Blender shader graphs.

reference.layout: Existing nine-card battle positions; Kaeya replaces the first friendly example card.

scope: Art assets only. Not bound to Unity combat or the independent Unity effects inspector.

Kaeya_GlacialWaltz_State.stage: appearance / uninterrupted loop / arbitrary-phase normal removal

Kaeya_GlacialWaltz_Effect.scope: Native Blender render after power-expression repair; original artwork, camera, reference layout and exports retained.

compositorRepair: Bind Render Layers to the retained scene and its actual ViewLayer before splitting/saving. No source geometry, target path or layout rebuild.

referenceCardCompletion.frontsAndFrames: Existing nine meshes and transforms preserved.
referenceCardCompletion.backs: Nine rounded default card backs, packed UI_Gcg_CardBack_01.png.
referenceCardCompletion.edges: Nine rounded reference shells, 0.048 m plus tiny rear-depth separation; attached to existing frame parenting.
referenceCardCompletion.exportScope: Reference geometry is excluded from effect exports; existing FBX files unchanged.

sourceLifecycle.notes: LifecyclePreview=0 restores the uninterrupted source loop. Old FBX loop frames1..73 remain pure loops. ReleaseAtSeconds is an authoring example, not a status duration or runtime event.

sourceLifecycleValidation.scope: Blender source only; original FBX parts and formal Unity timeline were not modified.

effectNativeValidation.powerReplacement: Mathematically equivalent pow calls; 352 current native drivers valid without Python autoexec.
